content.value_statement: Azure incidents are hard to triage across health, logs, metrics, and recent changes. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Azure diagnostics.
actual_capabilities: Guides a systematic Azure incident diagnosis flow.
Provides Azure CLI checks for resource health, activity logs, and Container Apps logs.
Maps common Container Apps symptoms to likely causes and fixes.
Supplies KQL patterns for recent errors, failed requests, slow requests, and dependency failures.
Shows Azure Resource Graph queries for unhealthy resources and service health incidents.
References MCP tools for AppLens, Azure Monitor, and Resource Health diagnostics.
limitations: It does not deploy applications or create new Azure resources.
It requires access to Azure CLI, MCP tools, or relevant Azure logs for live diagnosis.
It focuses mainly on Container Apps and general Azure health signals.
It does not replace Azure service documentation or incident owner judgment.

use_cases.title: Triage Container App Failures
use_cases.description: Diagnose image pull errors, cold starts, health probe failures, and port mismatches.

use_cases.title: Analyze Production Error Patterns
use_cases.description: Use KQL examples to inspect exceptions, failed requests, slow requests, and dependency failures.

use_cases.title: Check Azure Health During Incidents
use_cases.description: Review resource health, activity logs, and service health signals before deeper application debugging.

prompt_templates.title: Start Azure Triage
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me diagnose an Azure production issue. Ask for the failing resource, symptoms, timeframe, and recent changes.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot Container Apps
prompt_templates.prompt: My Azure Container App is failing. Guide me through checks for revisions, registry access, ingress, logs, and health probes.

prompt_templates.title: Build Log Queries
prompt_templates.prompt: Create KQL queries to investigate recent errors, failed requests, slow requests, and dependency failures for my application.

prompt_templates.title: Correlate Incident Signals
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me correlate Azure Resource Graph health data, activity logs, Container Apps logs, and KQL results into a root-cause summary.

output_examples.input: My Container App returns 503 after a new revision.
output_examples.output: The response should outline checks for revision status, ingress target port, health probes, recent logs, and rollback options.

output_examples.input: We see more failed requests in the last hour.
output_examples.output: The response should suggest targeted KQL queries for failed requests, exceptions, dependency failures, and slow endpoints.

output_examples.input: Several Azure resources look unhealthy during an incident.
output_examples.output: The response should compare resource health, service health events, provisioning states, and recent activity log entries.

best_practices: Start with resource health and recent changes before deep log analysis.
Use narrow time windows and result limits when querying logs.
Record symptoms, checks, findings, and attempted remediation steps.
anti_patterns: Do not run update commands in production without confirming impact.
Do not treat missing logs as proof that the service is healthy.
Do not ignore recent deployments, configuration edits, or scale changes.

faq.question: What Azure services does this skill cover best?
faq.answer: It is strongest for Azure Container Apps, Azure Monitor logs, Resource Health, and Resource Graph diagnostics.

faq.question: Can it run diagnostics automatically?
faq.answer: It provides commands and MCP tool patterns, but execution depends on the agent environment and user authorization.

faq.question: Does it create or deploy Azure resources?
faq.answer: No. It is for troubleshooting existing resources, not deployment or resource provisioning.

faq.question: Does it require Application Insights?
faq.answer: Application Insights or Log Analytics is needed for the provided KQL log examples.

faq.question: Can it help with Container Apps cold starts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for scale-to-zero behavior and minimum replica settings.

faq.question: Is it safe for production incidents?
faq.answer: Use it as diagnostic guidance and confirm any change command before applying it to production.
